class_id: substance predicate fed rows without a column it reads
symptom: a `SUBSTANCE_CHECKS` predicate reads `row.<col>` but the audit script's SELECT never selected `<col>`, so the predicate silently sees `undefined` and never flags a real violation (recurred: `audit-ipo-coverage.mjs` omitted `i.segment`; `audit-substance-plausibility.mjs` independently omitted `i.issue_type`, no-opping the two fixed-price-degenerate-band checks)
first_seen: T-297 (`audit-ipo-coverage.mjs` / segment); Sep 2026 (review-gap round, `audit-substance-plausibility.mjs` / issue_type, this PR)
fix_prs: T-297 fix (added `i.segment`) + this PR (added `i.issue_type`, plus an `evaluated N rows` print)
detection_check: `scripts/tests/audit-ipo-coverage.test.mjs` and `scripts/tests/audit-substance-plausibility.test.mjs` — both statically extract every `row.<col>` a `SUBSTANCE_CHECKS` predicate reads and assert the script's SELECT selects it, so deleting a column turns the test red without a live DB
